A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the game-text box of the 0 side) with the corrected game text and a white E in the black lower border, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 March 2017.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Endor-L-rebelstriketeam-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 25 January 2018): Same words as before. This is a slip: the lower part of the card with the white italic “E” in the black lower border; unlike the 2013 slip it prints no title.

The lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
